rating.sourceTitle: Poems by Emily Dickinson, Three Series, Complete

longDescription: This historical edition invites slower reading, with attention to sound, images and the shape of individual lines. You can read a few pieces at a time or move through the collection in sequence. Its language and editorial choices belong to the edition credited here; it is a particular collection rather than a modern collected works.

authorInfo.bio: Emily Dickinson was an American poet who spent most of her life in Amherst, Massachusetts. Her compact poems explore nature, death, belief and inner experience through striking imagery and unconventional rhythms. Much of her poetry appeared after her death; early editors changed some wording and punctuation.
authorInfo.edition: Historical editions edited by Mabel Loomis Todd and Thomas Wentworth Higginson (credits vary by series and are retained in the PDF). All three series in this collection, not every poem Dickinson ever wrote. Early editorial conventions are preserved. Source cover supplied by Project Gutenberg.

rightsReview.policy: Source states US public domain; listed creative contributors died by 1945. Unknown dates excluded. This is a screening record, not a legal certification.
